about: The Biira Bank lab inventory: every machine, where it lives and what it is for. Kept by hand, from the homelab README. Most of these are Linux or appliances, so Active Directory has never heard of them; this file is the only place the agent can learn what they are.

networks.name: Management
networks.purpose: Firewall, hypervisor and the admin workstation

networks.name: BlueTeam
networks.purpose: Defensive tooling: the SIEM and the vulnerability scanner

networks.name: RedTeam
networks.purpose: Attack simulation, contained by the firewall

networks.name: EnterpriseLAN
networks.purpose: The Windows domain: domain controller, certificate authority and workstations. Workstations get their address by DHCP, so they are not listed by IP

networks.name: Tailscale
networks.purpose: Remote access: the admin's devices reaching the lab through the Tailscale subnet router on the firewall

hosts.name: FW01
hosts.role: Gateway and firewall between every VLAN; Tailscale subnet router

hosts.name: ADM01
hosts.role: Administration workstation, where domain admin work is done

hosts.name: PVE01
hosts.role: Hypervisor that hosts the lab's virtual machines

hosts.name: SIEM01
hosts.role: Wazuh SIEM: collects and analyses logs from every agent

hosts.name: SCAN01
hosts.notes: Runs scheduled, authenticated scans of Windows machines as CORP\svc-greenbone, plus default-credential checks. Logons and probes from this address during a scan are expected; svc-greenbone signing in from any other address is not

hosts.name: KALI01
hosts.notes: Activity from here is a deliberate exercise, never routine

hosts.name: APP01
hosts.role: Application host for two internal web apps

hosts.name: DC01
hosts.role: Domain controller and DNS for corp.biirabank.com

hosts.name: CA01
hosts.role: Enterprise root certificate authority (AD CS); issued DC01's LDAPS certificate
